w10_T4_000360: On Saturday morning a garden centre unloaded 72 boxes of bedding plants, with 5 plants in every box. Later that morning a grower dropped off 72 loose plants at the gate, and at noon a school donated 70 more from its own beds. During the afternoon 164 plants were sold to weekend gardeners. In the evening a landscaper collected an order of 309 plants. How many plants are left at the garden centre?
w10_T4_000368: A parcel locker held 182 packages on Monday morning. Couriers took 54 of them out for delivery, and 75 fresh packages were dropped into the locker during the day. 13 packages went back to the depot as undeliverable, and 86 were collected by the people they belonged to. A neighbour then left 7 more in the locker for a friend. Every package still in the locker was labelled with 5 barcode stickers. The locker room is 4 metres wide. The depot's records list single packages rather than whole pallets. How many barcode stickers were used?
w10_T4_000371: A quiz club wrote 199 cards for its championship night, and every card carried 4 questions. All the questions were then split equally among the evening's 4 rounds. The host cut 108 questions from the first round because they were too easy for the finalists. Each question left in the first round is worth 3 points, and the winning team also receives a fixed bonus of 79 points. The hall holds 90 people. The score sheet is written in single points rather than in whole rounds. How many points could a team score in the first round including the bonus?
w10_T4_000376: A running club's kit store held 235 race numbers, and a sponsor posted 20 more before the season began. 176 of the numbers were handed out at the summer road race. Every number still in the store was then made up into a race pack with 7 safety pins beside it in the box. At the end the organiser tipped 11 loose pins into the same box. The club's entry list is written in minutes rather than in hours. How many safety pins are in the box?
w10_T4_000377: Nina had 143 minutes of raw footage from the school play and cut 95 minutes of it away. Her editing partner Ross, who had filmed far less than Nina did, handed her 38 minutes from his own camera, and a parent sent in 3 minutes shot on a phone. A second fixed camera contributed 63 minutes, and the sound engineer supplied 28 minutes of backstage clips. The archive is catalogued in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes of footage does Nina have now?
w10_T4_000380: Bela cut 155 lengths of elastic in her craft workshop, and each length made 8 wristbands. Every wristband was then threaded with 3 charms. All the charms were shared equally between the 2 stalls the workshop runs at the summer fair. Bela's stall, which sells more slowly than her partner Dmitri's, later had 844 charms taken away for restringing. How many charms are left on Bela's stall?
w10_T4_000381: On Thursday morning a market stall had 127 bread rolls and sold 109 of them before ten o'clock. At lunchtime the baker turned every roll still on the stall into 3 small sandwiches. During the afternoon 33 of those sandwiches were sold to office workers. In the early evening a caterer delivered 64 sandwiches to the same counter, and just before closing a neighbouring stall handed over 39 more. How many sandwiches are on the counter?
w10_T4_000387: On Monday morning a leisure centre had 151 lockers in use by its members. During the morning 23 of them were emptied and closed. In the afternoon 18 new members took lockers of their own, and in the early evening a further 5 were taken. That night the caretaker stuck 6 fresh labels on every locker that was in use. How many labels did the caretaker use?
w10_T4_000388: An apiary keeps 148 hives on the hillside, and every hive holds 9 frames. Each frame is divided into 7 panels, and every panel is fitted with 4 wax strips. The beekeeper also has 6 spare wax strips lying in the shed. The apiary is 3 kilometres from the village. How many wax strips does the apiary have altogether?
w10_T4_000399: On Friday morning a pottery stall had 125 mugs on display and a kiln delivery added 35 more. Before lunch a hotel buyer took 121 mugs for the restaurant. In the afternoon the workshop sent 73 fresh mugs down to the stall. In the evening the owner tripled the stall's stock ready for the weekend craft fair. How many mugs are on the stall now?
w10_T4_000402: On Saturday morning Fatima counted 115 cupcakes on her tray, and her co-baker Leo brought 65, fewer than Fatima had made. Before noon they divided all the cupcakes equally among the 3 charity stalls in the square. In the afternoon a neighbour gave the first stall 23 extra cupcakes. In the evening every cupcake on that first stall was topped with 6 sugar flowers, and a spare box supplied 76 more flowers for the display board. A dozen balloons were tied to the stall's corner post. How many sugar flowers were used at the first stall?
w10_T4_000406: On Wednesday morning a beach kiosk took in 129 packs of ice lollies, with 7 lollies in every pack. Before lunch a supplier added 80 loose lollies to the freezer. In the afternoon the owner decided to give 4 loyalty stamps away with every lolly in the freezer, and in the evening she printed 54 extra stamps to keep behind the counter. How many loyalty stamps did she prepare?
w10_T4_000410: On Tuesday morning a taxi driver had 117 minutes of prepaid waiting time on his meter card. During the morning 77 minutes were used up on airport runs. Just before lunch a hospital trip took another 35 minutes. In the early afternoon the office credited him 78 minutes for a cancelled booking, and later 60 minutes went on a school run. In the evening a customer's prepaid booking added 65 minutes to the card. The card is topped up in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes are on the card at the end of the day?
w10_T4_000411: On Saturday morning a raspberry farm had 161 trays ready in the barn and sent 91 of them straight to the supermarket. Before noon the pickers worked out that 7 punnets could be filled from every tray still on the farm. During the afternoon each of those punnets was filled with 6 raspberries. In the evening all the raspberries were divided equally among the 5 jam pans, and the cook tipped 73 more from the cold store into the first pan. How many raspberries are in the first pan?
w10_T4_000416: On Friday morning a hardware store had 194 tins of paint on the shelves, and a delivery added 34 more. Before lunch 37 tins were sold to weekend decorators. In the afternoon a decorating firm bought 148 tins for a contract. In the evening the manager found that 3 sample pots could be filled from every tin still on the shelf, and 115 of those sample pots were sent off to a trade show. The store's sign above the door is 6 metres wide. How many sample pots are left?
w10_T4_000423: Rosa baked 24 flapjacks and shared them equally among the 6 children at the kitchen table. One of them, Milo, had his pile matched exactly by his aunt, so he ended up holding twice as many as Rosa had given him and more than his sister Ada kept. Milo ate 7 of his flapjacks during the afternoon. He then cut every flapjack he still had into 5 small squares for his lunchbox. The family recipe card is written in grams rather than kilograms. How many small squares did Milo make?
w10_T4_000427: A minibus set off to support a road race carrying 92 bottles of water. The first checkpoint took 18 bottles and the second took 37. Runners drank 20 at the halfway mark and another 6 at the finish line. The marshals used 8 more to refill the sponge buckets, and 2 were dropped on the road and split open. The race route is 21 kilometres long. How many bottles are left on the minibus?
w10_T4_000431: A jam factory packed 222 boxes with 4 jars in every box, and the sample room added 74 loose jars to the store. A supermarket order then took 698 jars away, and 60 jars came back when another order was cancelled. Each jar in the store holds 9 spoonfuls of jam. The factory chimney is 30 metres tall. The recipe book is written in grams rather than in kilograms. How many spoonfuls of jam are in the store?
w10_T4_000433: A chess club owned 15 boards, though 1 of them had a cracked hinge and was thrown out. A retiring member then donated a set that left the club with twice as many boards as it had just counted. The local school passed on 27 boards it no longer wanted, and a club closing down in the next town sent 69. How many boards does the chess club have now?
w10_T4_000434: Kofi had 19 model cars on his shelf, and his cousin Amara gave him 69, far more than he had collected himself. He then found 5 more in a box in the attic. He sold 63 of the cars at a car boot sale one Sunday, and bought 38 at a collectors' fair the following month. On his way home he gave 1 to his neighbour's son. How many model cars does Kofi have now?
w10_T4_000436: A council depot had 178 bags of grit at the start of winter. A supplier delivered 17 bags, a neighbouring depot sent over 70, and a farmer returned 9 he had never used. The gritting lorries got through 234 bags during the long cold spell, and 13 bags split open in the rain and were wasted. The depot's records are kept in single bags rather than in tonnes. How many bags of grit are left?
w10_T4_000441: On Monday morning a call-out engineer had 97 minutes of work booked in his diary. Before lunch one customer added 8 minutes to a job and the office booked him another 31. In the afternoon a further job added 13 minutes, and in the evening a night call added 72 minutes. The company charges 9 cents for every minute the engineer works. The invoice is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents will the booked work come to?
w10_T4_000451: Elin's courier round covers 239 stops, and loading at each stop used to take 7 minutes. A new depot layout cut 1299 minutes from that monthly total. A shortcut between two streets saved another 180 minutes, and the new trolleys, which her colleague Dev did not need on his much shorter round, saved a further 147 minutes. The depot charges 8 cents for every minute a van spends loading. The bill is issued in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents does Elin's round now cost in loading time?
w10_T4_000455: Gustav's fruit farm has 174 rows of blackcurrant bushes, with 3 bushes standing in every row. A disease swept through and killed 189 of the bushes. Every bush that survived carries 7 sprigs of fruit, and each sprig holds 3 berries. Gustav's partner Isla, who tends fewer rows than he does, picked 5887 berries for the jam kitchen. How many berries are still on the bushes?
w10_T4_000458: On Sunday morning the village fete's tombola table held 105 prizes. Before ten o'clock a shop donated 35 more and a family brought in 39. During the late morning 15 prizes were won and carried away, and in the afternoon a further 77 went to winners. In the early evening the raffle organiser transferred 80 unclaimed prizes onto the tombola table. Each prize left on the table was then wrapped with 4 strips of tape for storage. A dozen bunting flags hung over the stall. How many strips of tape were used?
